description: Command-backend recipes. Each shot wraps a program that writes images into {out_dir}; it runs in a scratch {work_dir}, so relative paths other than the program itself are written as {manifest_dir}/... Paths and flags are placeholders: adapt them to your project.

defaults.comment: Every game shot starts from this argv; @common splices the shared flags, and a shot's argv+ appends its own.

shots.name: title-desktop
shots.comment: A native desktop game with its own screenshot flags, on a private Xvfb display.
shots.caption: The title screen at 1280x720.

shots.name: title-compare
shots.comment: Two builds, same shot: darkroom shoot media.json --only title-desktop --tag before --var game=./old/MyGame, then --tag after.
shots.caption: Title screen, previous build vs this one.

shots.name: season
shots.comment: One run per value: writes season-spring.jpg ... season-winter.jpg.
shots.caption: The world in each season.

shots.name: seasons
shots.comment: A README composite, replacing an existing image in place.
shots.title: The four seasons
shots.caption: The same field through the year.
shots.alt: Four views of one field: spring, summer, autumn and winter

shots.name: strata-scene
shots.comment: An engine's own headless renderer (no browser): render one scene to a PNG.
shots.caption: A Strata scene rendered headless.

shots.name: territory
shots.comment: A RAM-heavy rig (throwaway server + bot + render): one at a time machine-wide via the lock; repeat runs it per camera step.
shots.caption: Claimed territory, orbiting the camera.
shots.alt: Animation: the claimed chunks seen from six angles
